PREDICATE.primary_metric: strict JSON condition_z accuracy on held-out freight_buffer broad-support evaluation

POLICY.primary_metric: strict JSON action accuracy on held-out release_station evaluation
POLICY.purpose: separability/feasibility gate, not a co-visibility arm comparison

policy_execution_rule: Run POLICY_FACTORIZED for all six fresh seeds only because the pre-outcome NF4 admission gate admitted policy training.

inheritance_requires: same CUDA/runtime package identity on critical packages
new maximum training sequence <= old qualified maximum training sequence
new two-run one-step repeatability PASS before scientific training

sequence.dataset_order: per-seed deterministic permutation, identical between paired predicate arms
sequence.loss_scope: assistant content plus <|im_end|>; user/role text excluded

hard_stops: No trained-arm execution before new input lock, runtime tokenizer replay, inherited-profile binding, and repeatability PASS.
No seed extension beyond the six frozen seeds.
No evaluator outcome may change optimization, prompt, margin support, arm order, or thresholds.
No policy result may be used to retrospectively redefine the predicate question.
No K1/K2/K4 or optimizer-window scientific screen runs in parallel.
